description: Evaluate "can this principal do this action on this scope, and WHY?" against a vendor-neutral identity/RBAC model that mirrors Azure RBAC, AWS IAM/Organizations, GCP Resource Manager or Kubernetes RBAC — each rule verified against the official docs (access.md). Returns a three-valued verdict — allowed / denied / indeterminate (an unmodelled condition would decide it) — with a step-by-step trace of which rule decided and why. Nothing is looked up online: you must pass the scenario data yourself in "world".

plane.description: Azure only: control-plane or data-plane action (Azure keeps them as separate grant sets; ignored for the other providers).

world.description: Scenario data. Shape depends on "provider" — azure: {ambitos, pertenencias?, roles?, asignaciones?, denegaciones?}; aws: {ambitos, cuentasGestion?, identidades?, recursos?, scps?, boundaries?}; gcp: {ambitos, pertenencias?, roles?, bindings?, denyPolicies?}; k8s: {ambitos, pertenencias?, roles?, bindings?}. See access.md for the exact field shapes, worked examples and the official-docs citation behind every rule.

name: access_check
